problems.problem: Bottle appears to float above the surface due to shadow offset_y=0 (detached shadow) and product_base_y=1245 (bottle base 195px above canvas bottom, 13.5% margin). Visible contact cues (shadow proximity, surface texture) are missing, violating deterministic geometry.
Asymmetric balance: bottle occupies 48% of canvas height (below 50% hero standard) and is right-aligned, while text is left-aligned. Negative space is uneven, reducing visual harmony.
Lacks the dramatic, cohesive lighting of professional luxury campaigns (e.g., Tom Ford/Armani Prive). Lighting feels generic, not integrated with the product or background.
Disconnected elements: text (left) and bottle (right) lack visual connection. Background texture (stone) and bottle (gold/pearl) have mismatched tones, weakening the luxury concept.
